module.quote.name: TSQ Quote — Quote Card
module.quote.description: /quote turns a message from this server into a quote image with its author's black-and-white profile picture.
cmd.quote: Turn a message into a black-and-white quote card
cmd.quote.channel: Channel of the message when you give a bare ID (default: this channel)
quote.invalid_reference: Enter a valid message ID or Discord message link.
quote.other_guild: Only messages from this server can be quoted.
quote.not_found: Message not found, or you don't have access to it.
quote.no_text: This message has no text that can be quoted.
quote.content_unavailable: Discord does not show this message's text to the bot, so it cannot be quoted. (The bot's Message Content intent is off; tell a server admin.)
quote.age_restricted: A message from an age-restricted channel cannot be quoted into a channel without the age restriction.
quote.post_failed: The quote card could not be posted in this channel. Make sure the bot may attach files here.
